title: Detecting Hate and Inflammatory Content in Bengali Memes: A New Multimodal Dataset and Co-Attention Framework
reasoning: The paper presents a multimodal dataset and framework for detecting hate speech and inflammatory content in memes. While the dataset includes examples targeting religious groups, the study's focus is on the technical task of classification and performance benchmarking for low-resource languages rather than a specific evaluation or benchmarking of religion, morals, or ethics.
